title: runVerify
responsibility: Resolves trusted revision ranges, runs or checks verification records, reports build identity, stamps built files, and re-exports the report-only plan API.

inputs.name: verifyRun.options
inputs.description: Selects an exact source commit, optional trusted base or entity and check settings. Artifact retention selects a declared output and requires full verification.

inputs.name: verifyCheck.options
inputs.description: Optional settings for the check: `commit` is the revision whose record is checked (default `HEAD`), `record` is a record id or a path to a record file (a relative path resolves against `root`; when omitted, the most recent record of the commit, whatever its outcome, is checked), and `root` is the repository directory (default: the current directory).

inputs.name: verifyIdentity.directory
inputs.description: The built directory to identify, resolved against the current directory: every file in it, nested ones included, is hashed, and the call fails when it holds no file.

inputs.name: verifyStamp.directory
inputs.description: The built directory to stamp, resolved against the current directory: each file that holds a `harness-build:` slot of 64 lowercase hex digits (empty or already stamped) is rewritten in place with the directory's build id, and the call fails when no file holds a slot.

inputs.name: renderVerify.stored
inputs.description: The verification result to render: its record (status, source commit, base and requested base, tests, scenarios, failures, and id) and the directory that stores it, plus the optional attachment, which only entity runs set.

failures: Scoped to reports.component.evidence-grid: only its scenario states ran, so this record is partial and never a full pass.

outputs.name: verifyRun
outputs.description: Returns the record and its directory. An opted-in passing full record identifies the retained generated file, its source path, byte count and SHA-256.

failures: Scoped to reports.component.evidence-grid: only its scenario states ran, so this record is partial and never a full pass.

outputs.name: verifyCheck
outputs.description: The verdict on the stored record for its commit: `status` is `passed` only when `problems` is empty, and `record` is the record id. `problems` lists identity and integrity problems, lineage problems only when those pass, and recorded failures only when the record did not pass.

outputs.name: verifyIdentity
outputs.description: The absolute directory, the `buildId` (a SHA-256 over each file's path and content hash, with stamp slots hashed as empty), the number of `files` covered, and the `stamp` found in the files, present only when a file holds a written stamp.

outputs.name: verifyStamp
outputs.description: The absolute directory, the `buildId` written into every stamp slot (stamping leaves it unchanged, since slots are hashed as empty), the number of `files` covered, and the same value as `stamp`.

outputs.name: renderVerify
outputs.description: The human-readable summary: a `Verification <status> for <commit>.` line, a `Compared with` line when the requested base could not be used, the test and scenario counts, each failure indented by two spaces, the first 12 characters of the record id with the directory that stores it, and an attachment line when there is an attachment.

outputs.name: verifyPlan
outputs.description: The report-only plan of the checks selected for a commit, each marked `candidate`, `singleton`, or `ineligible`, plus the candidate groups that share a runner, working directory, timeout, and command template; it executes no check and restores no evidence.

examples.note: Candidates describe matching command shapes; checks remain uncombined and are not executed.
examples.sideEffects: Does not restore evidence or run planned checks; impact analysis may invoke the selected local kernel.

source.selectionNote: Uses the nearest passing base already in local cache. A run may restore a newer attached base and select fewer checks.

checks.reason: Could not prove the declared runner and one literal test-file argument match this check; command remains ungrouped.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by `fail()` for expected, user-facing problems: an invalid repository or revision, an unknown or unavailable runtime (verifyPlan also refuses http), an invalid `harness.verify.json`, an entity no scenario covers, a missing or unknown verification record, a directory with no built files or no build-stamp slot, or a record that cannot be attached.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by `JSON.parse` when `harness.verify.json` in the verified commit is not valid JSON.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown when the resource priority, or `HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY` when no priority is given, is not `agent-test`, `coding`, or `environment`.
